domain.Core banking: Core banking engines, ledgers, account servicing or explicitly named core banking platforms. Generic banking is insufficient.
domain.Private banking: Explicit private-bank services or private-banking systems. Wealth management alone is insufficient.
domain.Wealth and investment management: Wealth, portfolio, fund or investment-management systems. Separate from execution and exchange infrastructure.
domain.Banking: Explicit banking applications without a supported narrower banking category.
domain.Payments and fintech: Payment processing, settlement, card systems, reconciliation or explicitly identified fintech financial products.
domain.Financial markets and trading: Exchanges, market risk, trade execution, trading platforms or market infrastructure.
domain.Insurance: Insurance policies, claims, underwriting or technology explicitly serving an insurer.
domain.Crypto and digital assets: Cryptocurrency, blockchain financial products or digital-asset exchanges.
domain.Financial regulation: Financial-sector supervision, regulatory reporting or regulatory authority systems. Do not merge with commercial banking.
domain.Government services: Explicit government-agency, public administration, community-services or statutory-board projects. Employer ownership alone is insufficient.
domain.Public healthcare: Explicit public hospitals or public healthcare systems.
domain.Healthcare: Clinical, medical, health-tech or private healthcare systems; public ownership not established.
domain.Public education and research: Explicit public education, university or publicly funded research work.
domain.Education: Private education, learning products or education work whose public status is not established.
domain.Semiconductors and electronics: Chip fabrication, semiconductor materials, electronic testing or semiconductor business systems.
domain.Manufacturing and industrial systems: Factory operations, industrial controls, manufacturing AI, industrial IoT or production automation.
domain.Transport and aviation: Rail, fare collection, airport, airline, aircraft simulation or air-traffic systems. Keep client identity uncertainty in reasoning.
domain.Logistics and supply chain: Warehouses, shipping, ports, logistics integration or supply-chain operations.
domain.Energy and utilities: Electricity, demand response, energy trading operations, utilities or sustainability infrastructure.
domain.Retail and commerce: Retail transactions, ecommerce, consumer finance tied to commerce or commercial food-and-beverage systems.
domain.Media, social and gaming: Publishing, video, social networks, advertising, creative content or gaming products.
domain.Enterprise business software: CRM, ERP, HCM, Salesforce, SAP or explicitly supported business workflow products without a narrower client industry.
domain.AI and data products: AI, data, analytics or database products with no established narrower end-user industry. Using Python or AI alone is insufficient.
domain.Cloud, infrastructure and cybersecurity: Cloud, network, developer tooling, infrastructure or security products with no established narrower client industry.
domain.Other supported domain: A clearly evidenced project domain outside this taxonomy. Explain the domain and flag it for taxonomy review.
domain.Unclear: The listing does not establish a project or product domain. Generic technologies, recruiter identity and company portfolios are insufficient.

role.Backend development: Implementing server-side application logic, APIs or backend services.
role.Frontend development: Implementing browser interfaces or frontend applications.
role.Full stack development: Explicit responsibility for both frontend and backend development.
role.Mobile development: Implementing Android, iOS or other mobile applications.
role.Software development: Software engineering is established but a narrower role is not.
role.Data engineering: Building ingestion, ETL, data pipelines, warehouses or data platforms.
role.AI and machine learning: Developing, evaluating or deploying ML models, AI systems or agentic applications as a central responsibility.
role.Platform and DevOps: Software delivery infrastructure, cloud platforms, SRE or developer tooling.
role.Support and operations: Maintaining, troubleshooting or operating applications, databases or infrastructure.
role.Quality engineering: Software testing, test automation, validation or quality assurance.
role.Security engineering: Cybersecurity engineering, threat hunting, security analysis or technical security auditing.
role.Embedded and firmware: Embedded software, firmware or hardware-facing software development.
role.Architecture and technical leadership: Architecture or technical direction is central; a senior title alone is insufficient.
role.Management: People, delivery, project or engineering management is central.
role.Analysis and consulting: Business analysis, functional consulting, integration consulting or presales is central.
role.Other supported role: A clearly described role outside these choices. Explain and flag it.
role.Unclear: Available text does not establish the main responsibilities.

technology.Java: Java programming language, JVM application development or an explicitly relevant Java stack.
technology.C#/.NET: C#, .NET, ASP.NET or explicitly relevant Microsoft application development.
technology.Python: Python programming language is explicitly relevant to the job.
technology.Other explicit technology: Other technologies are explicitly named but none of the three target stacks is established.
technology.Unclear: The text does not establish technology relevance. Absence of a technology name is not evidence it is unused.
